01What keeps a planet in orbit?Gravity & motion+

Gravity continually bends a planet’s path. Its sideways motion carries it forward, producing an orbit when the conditions are right.

Explore orbital motion ↗
02How do waves make a pattern?Waves & interference+

When waves overlap, their displacements add. Crests can reinforce each other, while a crest and a trough can cancel.
